title: The New Humans #1 2 3 Lot Pied Piper Comics 1987 Ex-Mutants Spinoff Ron Lim
condition_description: All three covers bright with no creases or tears; spines and staples intact. #3 has light toning along the top edge of the cover. See photos.
description:
The New Humans #1, #2 and #3 (1987), Pied Piper Comics - the Ex-Mutants spinoff series. Original $1.95 cover price each.

You get all 3 issues:
- #1 - back cover: Pied Piper character pin-up by Ron Lim (1986)
- #2 - ruined London / Big Ben cover; back cover: Pied Piper "Attention Retailers" ad
- #3 - mutant creatures cover; back cover: Pied Piper "Attention! Retailers!" notice

See photos for condition. Ships bagged together in a protective mailer.
